prompt:
We're building HintLab in this folder (empty git repo): a debugging tutor for programming labs, for a Cline hackathon where judges score effective use of the Cline SDK. A student pastes code + picks an assignment; an agent server built with @cline/sdk (npm, v0.0.90, needs Node 22+) runs the code against that assignment's test cases in a temp sandbox folder, figures out why it fails, and returns a hint at level 1 (nudge), 2 (where), or 3 (what concept). It must NEVER write the fixed code.

Stack: Node, TypeScript (type: module, tsconfig moduleResolution Bundler), run with tsx, Express server, plain HTML/JS frontend served by Express.
Structure:
- server/index.ts: POST /api/session {assignmentId, language, code} -> starts agent, returns sessionId; GET /api/session/:id/stream (SSE of agent steps); POST /api/session/:id/next-hint
- server/agent.ts: ClineCore session (start with interactive: true so follow-up send() works) with editor/apply_patch/fetch_web_content tools disabled, a shell approval callback allow-list (only python3 / gcc / running the test runner inside the sandbox folder), absolute paths for read_files, and a custom give_hint tool (createTool + zod, level 1-3, text only, registered via extraTools)
- server/runner.ts: deterministic test runner that compiles/runs code against tests.json and reports pass/fail per case
- assignments/<id>/: problem.md + tests.json (input -> expected output); 3 assignments (2 Python, 1 C)
- web/: one page: code box, assignment dropdown, live agent-steps panel, hint card, Next hint button

Plan only: list the files, the build order, what to verify after each step, and the risky parts. Keep it concise.
